description: This is a PHP class file defining a controller for managing subscription cron jobs within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles processing active subscriptions, validating order, customer, payment, shipping, and product details to create or update subscription records.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription operations executed via Cron jobs in the OpenCart system. It processes active subscriptions by validating associated order, customer, product, shipping, and payment details to perform updates or actions needed for subscription management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method called by the cron job, which retrieves active subscriptions based on next scheduled date, validates associated order, customer, product, shipping, and payment details, and performs necessary subscription management actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked by the cron job to process and update active subscriptions based on their next scheduled date, handling order validation, payment processing, and status updates.
